name: Australia
headline: Clinical intensive training and practitioner education in Australia.
summary: Australia has been an important region for international ZSA education, with intensive seminars, clinical demonstrations and professional exchange.

name: Asia
headline: The long-standing clinical and educational base of ZSA training.
summary: Asia forms the historical and clinical base of the educational work, including Taiwan, China, Japan, Malaysia and other regional professional exchanges.

name: Europe
headline: Professional exchange and international ZSA education in Europe.
summary: European activity includes professional exchange with Traditional Chinese Medicine organizations and international practitioner education.

name: North America
headline: Expanding professional and academic exchange in North America.
summary: North America is part of the ongoing international education strategy for ZSA, with emphasis on professional education, academic exchange and future structured training programs.
